title.en: Place a sell order on CoW Swap, with an allowance of exactly the amount to sell
title.zh-TW: 在 CoW Swap 下賣單，並授權剛好的數量

summary.en: The Safe does two things through MultiSend. First it gives CoW's vault relayer an allowance of exactly the amount to sell, then it calls `setPreSignature` on the settlement contract to pre-sign the sell order. The transaction holds only the order's hash. verify reads the full order back from CoW's API, computes the same hash, then compares each item. The allowance stays for the later fill, and it is at most the sell amount you type.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 用 MultiSend 做兩件事：先把要賣的數量剛好授權給 CoW 的 vault relayer，再呼叫結算合約的 `setPreSignature` 預簽賣單。交易裡只有訂單的雜湊，verify 從 CoW 的 API 讀回訂單原文，算出同一個雜湊後逐項比對。授權留著給之後成交用，最多就是你填的賣出數量。

text.en: The hash locks the order's contents, and the allowance is exactly the sell amount. verify depends on the CoW API.
text.zh-TW: 訂單內容由雜湊鎖住，授權剛好是賣出數量；verify 依賴 CoW API。

intro.en: CoW Protocol (CoW Swap): a trading protocol that matches orders in batch auctions. Solvers compete to fill the orders.
intro.zh-TW: CoW Protocol（CoW Swap）：用批次拍賣撮合的交易協議，訂單由 solver 競標成交。

text.en: G0 Group and Hacken audited the GPv2 contracts in 2021. The reports are in the audits folder of the contracts repo.
text.zh-TW: GPv2 合約 2021 年由 G0 Group 與 Hacken 審計，報告在合約 repo 的 audits 資料夾。

text.en: The Barter solver's contract had an arbitrary-call bug, and about 166,000 USD in fees that had built up in the settlement contract was taken. Users' funds were not affected.
text.zh-TW: Barter solver 的合約有任意呼叫漏洞，被拿走結算合約裡累積的手續費約 16.6 萬美元；使用者的錢沒有受影響。

text.en: verify must read the full order back from CoW's order API (api.cow.fi). When the API cannot be read, the result is UNVERIFIABLE. The API's answer is treated only as data, and it does not count if its hash does not match.
text.zh-TW: verify 要從 CoW 的訂單 API（api.cow.fi）讀回訂單原文。API 讀不到時結果是 UNVERIFIABLE。API 回的內容只當資料，雜湊對不上就不算數。

recommendation.en: On UNVERIFIABLE, do not sign. Wait until the API is back, then run verify again.
recommendation.zh-TW: UNVERIFIABLE 時不要簽，等 API 恢復再跑一次 verify。

text.en: You type the card's "minimum to receive" yourself. The CoW app's slippage differs with each quote (smart slippage), and there is no CoW quote on chain to read.
text.zh-TW: 卡片的「最少收到的數量」要你自己填：CoW app 的滑價每次報價不同（smart slippage），鏈上也沒有 CoW 的報價可讀。

recommendation.en: Type the minimum to receive that the CoW app shows. Do not type a lower one.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照 CoW app 顯示的最少收到數量填，不要填得更低。

text.en: The app fills the expiry and appData itself. The template limits the expiry to at most 7 days after the block (the app sets 30 minutes) and does not limit appData (may include a 0.1% partner fee). The fill still gives no less than the minimum you type, and only to the Safe.
text.zh-TW: 到期時間和 appData 這兩項 app 會自己填。到期時間模板限制在區塊時間後 7 天內（app 設 30 分鐘）；appData 模板不限制（可能含 0.1% 的合作方手續費）。成交仍不會少於你填的最少數量，也只給 Safe。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. If you no longer want the order before it expires, cancel it from the Safe.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受。訂單過期前不想要了，用 Safe 撤回。

text.en: On 14 April 2026 the cow.fi domain was hijacked for several hours and served a copy of the app that asked visitors to sign malicious transactions; CoW's contracts were not hacked. verify checks only the transaction you give it against your card.
text.zh-TW: 2026 年 4 月 14 日 cow.fi 網域被劫持數小時，假的 app 讓訪客簽下惡意交易；CoW 的合約沒有被駭。verify 只拿你給它的交易比對你的卡片。

recommendation.en: Open the CoW app from a saved bookmark, and run verify on every transaction it proposes before signing.
recommendation.zh-TW: 從存好的書籤打開 CoW app，它提出的每筆交易都先跑 verify 再簽。

pastTxsConclusion.en: In the sample of 2026-06-15 to 2026-11-24 (50-page cap; older not searched), 39 Safes' batches approved another amount than they sold: 28 unlimited, 11 more. Neither fits; approve exactly the sell amount.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 2026-06-15 到 2026-11-24 的抽樣裡（搜尋止於 50 頁上限，更早的沒查），39 個 Safe 的 39 筆批次授權和賣出數量不同：28 筆無上限，11 筆多於賣出數量。這些都不符合模板，授權必須剛好是要賣的數量。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.en: The order uid, 56 bytes: the order hash, the owner and the expiry joined together. The contract only records it as "pre-signed" and does not check its contents.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.zh-TW: 訂單 uid，56 bytes：訂單雜湊、擁有者、到期時間接在一起。合約只把它記成「已預簽」，不檢查內容。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.en: The order's EIP-712 hash. verify reads the full order back from CoW's order API and computes the hash itself. Only if the hashes match does it compare each item below.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.zh-TW: 訂單的 EIP-712 雜湊。verify 從 CoW 的訂單 API 讀回訂單原文，自己算雜湊，一樣才拿來比對下面每一項。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.receiv.en: Who gets the bought token. The CoW app fills in the Safe itself; any other address would send the money away.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.receiv.zh-TW: 買到的代幣給誰。CoW app 填 Safe 自己；填別的地址就會把錢送走。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.sellAm.en: The amount to sell. A sell order sells all of it.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.sellAm.zh-TW: 要賣的數量，賣單整筆賣出。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.buyAmo.en: The minimum amount to buy (the limit price). The settlement contract ensures the fill is no less than this.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.buyAmo.zh-TW: 最少要買到的數量（限價）。結算合約保證成交不少於這個數。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.validT.en: The order expires at this time (Unix seconds); the app sets it 30 minutes after the quote. A later expiry only keeps the order open longer: it still fills at most once, for no less than the card's minimum, to the Safe. The Safe can cancel it with `invalidateOrder`; one already expired cannot fill. The 7 days are a margin, not a measured need.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.validT.zh-TW: 訂單在這個時間到期（Unix 秒），app 設為報價後 30 分鐘。較晚到期只讓訂單開著更久：仍最多成交一次，不少於卡片的最低值，付給 Safe。Safe 可以用 `invalidateOrder` 取消；已過期的訂單不能成交。7 天是保留的餘裕，不是量出來的需要。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.appDat.en: The hash of the JSON the app attaches to the order (app name, slippage, fees, hooks). The settlement contract does not read it.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.appDat.zh-TW: app 附在訂單上的 JSON 的雜湊（app 名稱、滑價、手續費、hooks）。結算合約不讀它。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.feeAmo.en: The fee taken inside the order. It is 0 on every CoW order today.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.feeAmo.zh-TW: 訂單內扣的手續費，現在 CoW 的訂單都是 0。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.kind.en: sell means a sell order: it sells a fixed amount and buys at least the limit.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.kind.zh-TW: sell 表示賣單：賣出固定數量，買到至少限價。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.partia.en: false means it fills all at once, not in parts.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.partia.zh-TW: false 表示一次全部成交，不分次。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.sellTo.en: erc20 means it is taken from the Safe's ordinary token balance, not through the Balancer vault.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.sellTo.zh-TW: erc20 表示從 Safe 的一般代幣餘額扣，不用 Balancer vault。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.buyTok.en: erc20 means the bought token goes straight into the Safe's ordinary balance.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.buyTok.zh-TW: erc20 表示買到的代幣直接轉進 Safe 的一般餘額。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.owner.en: The order's owner. It must be the Safe that sends this transaction; the contract checks this too.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.owner.zh-TW: 訂單擁有者，必須是送出這筆交易的 Safe；合約也會檢查。

2.setPreSignature.orderUid.validTo.en: The same as the expiry in the order.
2.setPreSignature.orderUid.validTo.zh-TW: 跟訂單裡的到期時間相同。

2.setPreSignature.signed.en: true means pre-sign; false means cancel.
2.setPreSignature.signed.zh-TW: true 表示預簽；false 是撤回。

1.approve.spender.en: The spender: CoW's vault relayer. The CoW app's default allowance is unlimited; the template requires you to pick the exact amount in the app.
1.approve.spender.zh-TW: 被授權者：CoW 的 vault relayer。CoW app 預設授權無上限，模板要你在 app 選剛好的數量。

1.approve.value.en: The allowance amount. It must equal exactly the amount to sell.
1.approve.value.zh-TW: 授權的數量，必須剛好等於要賣的數量。
